scope: Actual final release; original 2.10 validator/update UI; real Chrome with synthetic chrome runtime, OPFS, picker permissions, backend and GitHub routes. No live registration, usage or hospital calls.
checks: Actual 2.17.0 payload and announcement pass the original 2.10.0 validator, file cap, identity and permissions
Changed access, missing legacy entry/background and corrupted files are rejected before writes
Every packaged HTML, module import, CSS asset and manifest entry resolves within the payload
Upgrade journals before mutation, commits manifest last and restores all original bytes after failure
Cart backend scope, four-digit enrollment, offline expiry and persistent disable policies remain compatible
Public updates use the fixed cart feed without credentials or patient payload
Real Chrome modules reuse 2.10 registration and remembered folder without a new registration or picker
One shared background owns registration and heartbeat; disable/re-enable/401 re-enrollment preserve strict metadata-only requests
Original 2.10 updater denies writes without permission, installs 2.17, records reopen and clears the completed journal after restart
Update lock rejects active captures/other work pages and blocks new operations until released
Management and update fixture produces no browser runtime errors and sends no live network traffic
